description: This file defines the class OneForOneBlockPusher, which handles pushing data blocks to a remote shuffle service in Apache Spark. It manages block push requests, responses, and error handling, and initiates the push process.

classes.name: OneForOneBlockPusher
classes.description: Handles pushing blocks to a remote shuffle service, managing responses and errors, and coordinating the push process.

methods.name: OneForOneBlockPusher
methods.description: Constructor initializing the block pusher with client, app info, block IDs, listener, and buffers.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Begins the process of pushing all blocks, sending upload streams for each block.

methods.name: checkAndFailRemainingBlocks
methods.description: Handles failure scenarios, deciding whether to fail only the failed block or remaining blocks based on error type.

methods.name: failRemainingBlocks
methods.description: Notifies listener of failure for specified block IDs.
